subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — scheduling and pre-call info
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the context on your use case and where Acme Robotics is with model selection. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you’re planning to run a production inference cluster for the customer support agent + internal search reranker. Expected steady-state traffic during pilot ~10-20 QPS, peak up to ~50 QPS. Average prompt+response ~250 tokens, some longer debugging sessions up to 1,200 tokens.
- Goal for the next meeting: a 60-minute dedicated capacity sizing call (dev/infra + solutions engineering) to align on throughput/latency requirements, model variant (float vs quantized), and a pilot rollout plan. We’ll bring our solutions engineer (Mateo) to walk through runtime behavior and kernel tradeoffs.

Can you do one of these slots for the sizing call (PT)?
- Tue Feb 24 — 10:00-11:00am PT
- Mon Feb 23 — 1:00-2:00pm PT
- Wed Feb 25 — 11:00am-12:00pm PT

Before the call, could you share two quick items so we can optimize the session: 
1) Expected concurrency pattern (e.g., sustained vs bursty; typical active sessions).
2) Target latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and any strict p95/p99 constraints.

I attached a short sizing-template.xlsx to capture QPS, tokens/request, percent of requests that are cacheable/batchable, and retention requirements — if you can fill that out it’ll speed the call.

Thanks — I’ll hold the Tue 10am slot tentatively until I hear back.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@acmerobotics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmerobotics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Hi Camila —

Great recap and thanks for the follow-up. Tue 24 at 10:00am PT works for our team — we’d like a 60-90 minute slot if possible so our infra lead can share load patterns. Quick answers to your pre-call questions: 

- Current plan (pilot): steady-state ~10-20 QPS, peak bursts up to ~50 QPS for short windows (~3-5 minutes).
- Average tokens/request (roundtrip): ~250 tokens; 95th percentile around 900-1200 tokens for verbose conversations.
- Target latency: p95 target < 250ms for the primary assistant; p99 soft target < 500ms (we understand production tradeoffs).
- Batchability: most requests are small and highly parallel — some batching possible on the reranker path, but low batching on assistant channel.

I’ve attached a short internal doc that summarizes requirements and constraints (acme_requirements.pdf). Please add Mateo from your SE team — I’ll bring our infra lead Alex and product manager. 

See you Tue 02/24 at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Jordan Liu
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Robotics
jordan.liu@acmerobotics.com

Attachment: acme_requirements.pdf (PDF)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Perfect — thanks for the details and the doc, Jordan. We’ve booked Tue 24 Feb 10:00-11:30am PT to give extra buffer for walk-throughs (calendar invite attached). Mateo will lead the sizing portion and Marissa will cover pricing/commit options.

Pre-call asks (to make the session actionable):
- If you can paste a short sample of your traffic distribution (QPS over a 24h window) or a simple CSV we can load that into our sizing tool, that’d be ideal.
- Please confirm any strict networking/firewall constraints (e.g., white-listed IP ranges) so we can prep for Private/Dedicated deployment implications.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-redwood-sizing-20260224
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/D-2026-1138

I attached the sizing-template.xlsx again — feel free to fill what you can before the call.

Talk soon — looking forward to it.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@acmerobotics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmerobotics.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Thanks — invite received and added.

I dropped a short load-test summary (attached) that shows a recent simulated 50 QPS run with 250-token median + heavy tails; should give you a sense of variance. We’ll aim to fill the sizing-template before the call, but if we can’t I’ll have the infra lead share the CSV live.

See you Tue.

Jordan

Attachment: load_test_summary.pdf (PDF)
